scope: Static web rendering, element inspection, minimal OOXML edit, and untouched-part preservation for .pptx only

features.productBoundary: Strict ISO OOXML packages must open and render; edits remain minimal.
Common and custom slide sizes must retain aspect ratio and coordinates.
Masters and layouts affect static rendering but are not directly edited.
Theme colors and fonts must resolve for rendering and remain intact.
Placeholder inheritance is rendered and preserved, not directly edited in MVP.
Plain text in non-placeholder shapes is the primary editable content.
Multi-column text is rendered but not structurally rewritten.
Right-to-left paragraph layout is static-render and preservation scope.
Vertical text is rendered and preserved.
PowerPoint-compatible AutoFit is a renderer fidelity requirement.
Bullets and numbering render and survive unrelated edits.
Language metadata and alternate-language text properties remain intact.
Embeddable fonts are isolated per document for rendering and preserved in the canonical file.
Ungrouped non-placeholder shapes support text, position, size, fill, and alignment edits.
Connectors are selectable/read-only and preserved.
Custom geometry is rendered and preserved, not rewritten.
Groups and nested members are read-only in MVP.
Rotated geometry and text render and remain intact.
Solid shape fill is editable for supported shapes.
Gradient fills render and survive unrelated edits.
Pattern and bitmap fills are render/preserve scope.
Alpha and transparency effects are render/preserve scope.
Shadow, reflection, glow, and soft-edge effects are not directly edited.
3D shape and text effects are static-render and preservation scope.
Pictures are selectable/read-only and preserved.
Crop geometry must render without changing source media.
SVG, EMF, and WMF are static-render/preserve scope.
The editor shows a static preview; animation data is preserved.
Tables are selectable/read-only and preserved.
Charts and embedded workbooks are selectable/read-only and preserved.
SmartArt is selectable/read-only; visual fidelity is a known high-risk area.
WordArt geometry and effects are not rewritten.
Ink is static-render/read-only.
Audio and video playback is outside MVP; package parts must survive unrelated edits.
OLE is not activated in the browser; fallback image renders when present and bytes are preserved.
Equations are static-render/read-only.
Hyperlink relationships remain in the canonical PPTX.
External targets are neutralized only in disposable render copies and preserved canonically.
Speaker notes are not shown or edited in MVP.
Comments are not shown or edited in MVP.
Transitions are not played in the static web editor.
Animations are not played in the static web editor.
ActiveX never executes in the service; package preservation only.
Custom XML is opaque and must survive unrelated edits.
Section organization is retained but not exposed in MVP.
.pptm and VBA execution are outside the .pptx MVP boundary.
